The new year is in full swing, which means it’s the perfect time to refresh your small business’s digital marketing campaign! A large part of your success will depend on who you work with—a digital marketing agency, website design company or SEO company—and how efficiently you use your digital marketing and advertising budget. But if you aren’t digital marketing-savvy, don’t worry too much. That’s what the experts are for!

Working with a digital marketing company, internet marketing or online marketing agency, website design company or SEO company is a great way to get more bang for your buck. In fact, teaming up with the right digital marketing agency can be a game changer—it’s the equivalent of having an entire professional digital marketing team managing your business’s campaign for you.

So, if you’re…

Wondering if working with a digital marketing company, internet marketing or online marketing agency, website design company or SEO company is the right move for your business… it is!

Curious if SEO services (search engine optimization) can help you get found online by more of your ideal customers… it can!

Thinking about trying DIY website design… don’t, because there are better, more professional alternatives.

Now, let’s talk about three ways digital marketing can transform your Sioux Falls, South Dakota business and why it’s a good idea to work with a digital marketing company, internet marketing or online marketing agency, website design company or SEO company that knows how to appeal to your ideal customers—locally! But first, let’s take a look at some consumer data specific to the Sioux Falls market.

Consumer Data for Sioux Falls Business Owners

Did you know that 86% of Sioux Falls, SD’s 192.5k population has internet access at home? That’s a huge audience of more than 166,000 potential customers you could be reaching online right now with a strong internet marketing campaign.

But if you haven’t invested in professional website design, search engine optimization or social media marketing for your business, those potential customers might never know your business even exists. After all, there are nearly 15,000 other small businesses registered in Sioux Falls, so there’s a lot of competition to get noticed. You need to stand out from the rest, and your business’s website design and search engine optimization can help you do just that!

1. Attract More Customers With Professional Website Design

If you don’t yet have a website, one of the best things you can do for your Sioux Falls, SD business is to get in touch with a digital marketing company and invest in professional website design and SEO services. These two things are the foundation of any good digital marketing campaign and make all the difference in bringing in new leads and customers.

Think of your website as your business’s online storefront—it’s the cornerstone of your online presence and gives potential customers a place to:

  • Learn more about you and your business
  • Read about the products or services you provide
  • See your service area or store location
  • Get in touch with you and convert into a customer

Without a website and good website design, how are those potential customers going to find your business on Google? How will they know where to contact you? Short answer: They won’t, and they’ll go to one of your competitors, instead. Not good, right? But working with a digital marketing agency can change that.

2. SEO Services Help Your Ideal Customers Come to You

SEO services, or search engine optimization, are what move websites to the first page of Google. When used correctly, it can do the same for your website!

How many more clicks would you get if you were near the top of page one of Google search results for your industry and location? How many more people in Sioux Falls would see your business if you were the first to show up when they typed in a search query for the services you provide? SEO services are a powerful tool, which is why no small business should run a marketing campaign without it.

A digital marketing company, internet marketing or online marketing agency, website design company or SEO company can help you get set up. Professional search engine optimization analysts will be able to perform research to build a custom keyword list for your website. In turn, when those keywords are inserted into the content on your site, Google will take note and move you closer to the top of relevant searches over time.

Getting found online by more people is a huge benefit of working with a digital marketing agency, internet marketing agency or website design company, so sign up for SEO services (search engine optimization) today!

3. Capitalize on Sioux Falls Market Trends With a Personalized Campaign

Any digital marketing company, internet marketing or online marketing agency, website design company or SEO company you work with should be familiar with your local Sioux Falls market. Consumer habits and market trends as they relate to website design, SEO services (search engine optimization), social media marketing and more tend to vary from city to city and state to state, so finding a digital marketing agency that knows Sioux Falls will be invaluable to your business. That experience will allow them to:

  • Recommend products and services that fit your business’s long-term online marketing goals.
  • Apply digital marketing services that will appeal to your local audience.
  • Suggest improvements to your digital marketing campaign to help you get more leads.
  • Create a personalized marketing campaign, including professional website design, SEO services and reputation monitoring.
